messages.subject: PCA and missing data
parts:
Hi,

To check the robustness of patterns I see in my methylation data I have been carrying out PCA using data sets with different min.per.group levels (bases present in 5, 7, 9, 12 individuals).

However, I keep getting exactly the same PCA plot despite the huge differences in aligned bases among the different data sets.

Is this simply because the PCAsamples() function ignores bases where there is missing data?

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] PCA and missing data
parts:
yes, rows containing NA values are removed, otherwise PCA will not work unless you impute them first and then run PCA.

Best,
Altuna
